NAME: Force Maze Voice
DESCRIPTION: Moog Labyrinth-style thru-zero oscillator/wavefolder/filter voice (port of the Schwung 'Maze Voice' module for Ableton Move). Headless: control it from a Force MIDI track via CC, or from the web panel. NOTE: toggling RUNNING here only starts/stops the maze_host process itself - it does not arm the forceAudioIn.so LD_PRELOAD tap or restart acvs, so audio only reaches an Audio-In track if manage.sh ENABLE has already been run at least once this session. See README.md / CC-MAP.md.
